name: Ahoy

categories.label: Fame on the Fame track
categories.hint: Final marker position: region control each round (Squadron/Union), deliveries and rewards (Smugglers).

categories.label: Pledged Cargo bonus Fame (Smugglers only)
categories.labelVi: Fame từ Cargo đã cam kết (chỉ Smuggler)
categories.hint: At game end, per delivered Cargo: 1 Fame per region controlled by the pledged faction whose Island suit matches the Cargo suit.

categories.label: Gold remaining (tiebreaker)
categories.hint: Only used to break ties on Fame.

endCondition.description: At the end of a round, after region scoring, the game ends if any player has 30+ Fame; Smugglers then score pledged Cargo.

notes: family: area-majority. 2 players use Squadron + Union; 3 players add one Smuggler; 4 players use all four factions. Enter the Smuggler pledged Cargo Fame separately because it is added after the 30-Fame trigger. Expansions (Fish Folk, Rowdy Reefs) not modelled.

sources.title: Ahoy Rulebook (Leder Games, 2022)
